pages.text: Companions in $(thing)Follow$() or $(thing)Guard$() attack whatever hurts you.$(br2)$(thing)Heroic Intervention$(): if your health drops to 3 hearts or less, a nearby companion rushes to the creature attacking you.$(br2)Companions holding a $(item)shield$() raise it against arrows and incoming blows, and everyone tries to get away from creepers about to explode.

pages.title: Friendly Fire
pages.text: By default your attacks never hurt your own companions, and companions of the same owner never hit each other. An operator can change this: see $(l:epicvanguard:reference/friendly_fire)Friendly Fire$().
